subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: The direct inbound parser gap is clear, but exposing full card/form/select data changes channel message semantics and must preserve existing simple button command behavior.

options.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the card-action and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

options.title: Reduce to direct inbound only
options.body: Narrow this issue to `message_type: "interactive"` inbound card text extraction and leave callback fields and merge_forward behavior entirely to existing linked issues.

options.title: Defer full card payloads
options.body: Pause broad parsing until maintainers decide whether agents should receive only text extraction or fuller card/form payload envelopes.

recommendation.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the card-action and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin contact, and the decision is specific to the Feishu plugin’s agent-visible message contract.
